verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25760555 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318591 (dated 2025-12-04): item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 8,500 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-01-14. Terms EXW Boise, NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections and no stamps.
red_flags: Delivery terms are internally inconsistent: the document states EXW Boise (buyer normally bears freight, insurance and duties) but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. This means extra charges beyond the 6.11 USD unit price may appear on the invoice.
The document states 'DDP is not agreed' while the seller prepays duties and freight, which is unclear and should be clarified with the supplier.
The document has no date of its own. The only dates are the order date (2025-12-04) and the confirmed delivery date (2026-01-14).
observations: Single-page, machine-printed document; all values are clear.
No handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs are visible.
The quantity column is headed 'Qty' with no unit shown. It is recorded as quantity_confirmed because this is an order acknowledgement.
The description wraps across three lines in the table ('Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5').
